speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Could you tell me exactly how many hours after birth your baby started vomiting, and did you notice if the vomit was green? Also, has the baby passed any stool since being born?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor
text: I notice the infant has a distended abdomen and bilious vomiting; can you tell me if the baby has passed any meconium at all since birth? Also, did the home birth involve any signs of respiratory distress or difficulty feeding in the first few hours?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Bilious vomiting. I also have Inability to pass meconium, Abdominal distension.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Abdominal X-Ray. I also need to know if the baby has been feeding well or if there is any blood in the stool.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal X-ray shows dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, suggestive of a distal obstruction. Rectal Biopsy histopathology reveals an absence of ganglion cells in the submucosa and myenteric plexus, consistent with Hirschsprung’s disease.
